item.name: Returns a list of users with a specific organization role.

request.name: Returns a list of users with a specific organization role.

description.content:
Returns a list of users with a specific organization role, based on the organization role key.
Use query parameters to filter the result based on different criteria.

API Client needs the **User management > View members** permission.

query.description:
Filters list by name or email. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

Filters list by name, email, or username. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`
Maximum number of results returned. The value must be within 1 - 100 (both inclusive). The default value is 100.
Starting point or position of the first result returned. The default value is 0.
Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". The default is name. Allowed: userKey, name, email, status, lastLoginAt.
